additional_requirements.title: Test immutability of all aspects of the pipeline infrastructure and configuration
additional_requirements.text: Verify that the pipeline orchestrator, its configuration, and all other aspects of the build environment are immutable.

additional_requirements.title: Test logging of the build environment
additional_requirements.text: Verify that the build environment is logged and stored in a centralized organizational log store.

additional_requirements.title: Test automation of the build environment creation
additional_requirements.text: Verify that the deployment of the build environment is automated and can be easily redeployed.

additional_requirements.title: Test limitation of access to build environments
additional_requirements.text: Verify each build environment is accessible only to known and authorized users.

additional_requirements.title: Test requirement of user authentication to access the build environment
additional_requirements.text: Ensure authentication is required to access the build environment.

additional_requirements.title: Test automatic scanning of build infrastructure for vulnerabilities
additional_requirements.text: Verify that your build infrastructure is automatically scanned for vulnerabilities.

additional_requirements.title: Test non-usage of default passwords
additional_requirements.text: For each build tool, ensure the password used is not the default one.

additional_requirements.title: Test securing of webhooks in the build environment
additional_requirements.text: For each webhook in use, ensure it is secured (HTTPS).

additional_requirements.title: Test setting of minimum number of administrators for the build environment
additional_requirements.text: Verify that the build environment has only the minimum number of administrators.

additional_requirements.title: Test ensuring each pipeline has a single responsibility
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, ensure it has only one responsibility in the build process.

additional_requirements.title: Test limiting of build secrets to the minimal necessary scope
additional_requirements.text: For each build tool in use, review the secrets defined and the permission scopes they are assigned.
